original: Ally: A target of your type (Hero, Villain, Environment) other than yourself. Bury: Put the indicated card on the bottom of the associated deck. If that deck has zero cards in it, the card goes to trash instead. Collect: Search your deck for the indicated amount of the indicated cards and put them in your hand. Shuffle your deck. Discover: Reveal cards from the top of the deck until you reveal the indicated cards. Shuffle the other revealed cards into the deck. Play the cards in the order revealed. Reaction: When a Hero target would be dealt damage by a non-Hero target, it may activate any reaction text on cards already in play that give that Hero target a reaction. Like powers, each reaction can only be activated once per turn. Salvage: Search your trash for the indicated amount of the indicated cards and put them in your hand. Summon: Search the trash and/or deck for the indicated amount of the indicated cards. Play the cards found. If you searched the deck, shuffle it. For more explanation of terms, see pages 15-17 of the rulebook.
translation: 盟友：与你类型相同（英雄、反派或环境）、但并非你自身的目标。 埋藏：将指定的牌置于其所属牌库底。若该牌库中没有牌，则改为将该牌置入弃牌堆。 搜集：从你的牌库中查找指定数量、符合要求的牌，将其加入你的手牌。洗混你的牌库。 发现：从牌库顶逐张展示卡牌，直到展示出指定的牌。将其余展示的牌洗回牌库。按展示顺序打出指定的牌。 反应：当非英雄目标将要对英雄目标造成伤害时，该英雄目标可以发动已在场的卡牌赋予它的任意反应。与异能一样，每个反应每回合只能发动一次。 回收：从你的弃牌堆中查找指定数量、符合要求的牌，将其加入你的手牌。 召唤：从弃牌堆和／或牌库中查找指定数量、符合要求的牌。打出找到的牌。若查找过牌库，则洗混该牌库。 更多术语说明，请参阅规则书第15-17页。
